The Video Game Industry (as young as it is) was originally built on the premise that the cost of the disc, was deserved by the quality of the game. 

Over the years, that equation changed, incorporating microtransactions, on disc DLC, and other monetization techniques. The cost of the disc no longer guaranteed a complete product, and now, as a final stage evolution of that change... the data that we generate with human decision making, may just become the mechanism where mainstream commercial video games, sort of stop being games entirely.
